charter.goal: Make ordinary project folders/ZIPs behave as a revisioned, semantic, agent-native living workspace without replacing canonical source files.
protected_invariants: project code is not executed during indexing
generic shell absent from agent protocol
weak evidence is never silently upgraded to exact/semantic

belief_updates.initial_belief: Per-file compile cache is sufficient to call refresh incremental.
belief_updates.rival: Graph persistence can still rewrite the whole semantic database even when parsers are reused.
belief_updates.probe: Instrument relation/occurrence persistence on no-op and one-file refresh.
belief_updates.observation: Alpha.2 globally replaced graph rows; alpha.3 no-op stress reports 2918 relation and 3429 occurrence rows unchanged with zero insert/update/delete.
belief_updates.change: Set-diff relation/occurrence synchronization with graph_delta receipts.

belief_updates.initial_belief: One project-root semantic cache is a reasonable invalidation boundary.
belief_updates.rival: Provider domains should depend only on source and toolchain inputs relevant to them.
belief_updates.probe: Mutate Markdown and Python separately; inspect TypeScript/base provider reuse.
belief_updates.observation: On supplied AGI corpus, Markdown mutation hashes/compiles one file while base and TypeScript domains both reuse; Python mutation invalidates base but reuses TypeScript.
belief_updates.change: Provider-domain digests/fingerprints and independent semantic caches.
belief_updates.verifier: document/provider-domain tests + AGI-ZIP stress documentation/code probes

belief_updates.initial_belief: A live filesystem watcher can be the synchronization authority.
belief_updates.rival: Metadata observers can miss same-size/restored-mtime edits and must only accelerate candidate discovery.
belief_updates.probe: Change source bytes while preserving size and mtime, then attempt consequential mutation.
belief_updates.observation: Metadata lane can miss the edit; deep mutation reconciliation detects it.
belief_updates.change: Background watcher is observation-only; foreground targeted admission; mutation stage/commit/rollback retain deep hashing.

belief_updates.initial_belief: Orientation plus object inspection is already sufficiently agent-native.
belief_updates.rival: Repeated inspect/source calls preserve human-style navigation choreography under semantic names.
belief_updates.probe: Count calls and exact-source materialization needed for task packets.
belief_updates.observation: A bounded one-call task packet can materialize selected symbol bodies while files remain metadata-only.
belief_updates.change: Context Materializer with revision binding, source byte budget, object budget and explicit omissions.
belief_updates.verifier: materializer/stale/schema tests + alpha3 demo; model-level benefit remains unadmitted

belief_updates.initial_belief: Literal DOM id/testid can be mapped directly to framework source ownership.
belief_updates.rival: Duplicate anchors and build/runtime transformations make ownership ambiguous.
belief_updates.probe: Create unique and duplicate TSX anchors and inspect runtime source hints.
belief_updates.observation: Unique anchors produce parser candidates; duplicates cannot support unique ownership. A same element carrying equal id/testid initially produced duplicate semantic IDs.
belief_updates.change: Deduplicate parser anchor identity; emit renders edges; unique runtime correlations stay parser-grade and ambiguous correlations become heuristic.
belief_updates.verifier: unique/duplicate JSX owner tests + alpha3 demo

belief_updates.initial_belief: Engineering plumbing measurements can support claims of lower LLM token use.
belief_updates.rival: A deterministic filesystem baseline is not an agent/model baseline and may be intentionally weak.
belief_updates.probe: Build disclosed navigation harness and separately specify controlled same-model benchmark contract.
belief_updates.observation: Both arms find all three synthetic targets; Habitat requests 100–132 exact source bytes plus bounded task packets versus 12,219 source bytes scanned by the disclosed baseline, but this does not measure an LLM trajectory.
belief_updates.change: Keep report labeled plumbing-only; include same-model repeated-trial contract without fabricated results.

negative_results_preserved.failure: Navigation benchmark crashed because sqlite3.Row was treated as dict.get-capable.
negative_results_preserved.correction: Use storage row contract; rerun before admitting report.

negative_results_preserved.failure: JSX element with identical id/data-testid emitted duplicate stable symbol ID.
negative_results_preserved.correction: Deduplicate anchor/line parser emission and add regression.

negative_results_preserved.failure: First admission invocation omitted required source_zip for AGI stress harness.
negative_results_preserved.correction: Fail-fast retained; entire evidence chain rerun with supplied AGI ZIP.

negative_results_preserved.failure: Release summary helper expected verification.execution while demo contract exposes verification.receipt.
negative_results_preserved.correction: Read typed report schema rather than inventing fields; raw report remained valid.

negative_results_preserved.failure: RC pip smoke with default build isolation attempted unavailable package-index access for setuptools>=68.
negative_results_preserved.correction: Classified as environment/dependency-fetch failure; reran with --no-build-isolation --no-deps using installed setuptools 82.0.1 and verified isolated import/version.

admission_evidence.tests: 71/71 PASS in current source tree before packaging

claim_boundary: Admit bounded workspace plumbing/semantic mechanisms only. No universal token reduction, coding-success uplift, AGI capability, hostile-code sandbox or framework-complete ownership claim.
